# Rafiqy

Rafiqy is a privacy-first browser tools and decision systems site for everyday digital work. It focuses on typing, Urdu input, tax planning, solar planning, investing, PDFs, writing, and practical browser-based utilities, with strong Pakistan-specific depth where that context matters.

Key pages:
- https://rafiqy.app/
- https://rafiqy.app/tools
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/stock-planner
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/typing-tutor
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/urdu-keyboard
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/tax-calculator
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/solar-planner
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/investment-allocation-planner-pakistan
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/rent-vs-buy-calculator-pakistan
- https://rafiqy.app/tools/petrol-vs-hybrid-vs-ev
- https://rafiqy.app/blog

Guidance:
- Most tools run locally in the browser.
- Public content is intended for discovery, summarization, and citation.
- The homepage positioning is: "Your everyday digital companion."
- Many pages are intentionally written to match generic search phrasing first, with Pakistan-specific assumptions and reality layered into the explanation and logic.
- Tax and solar pages are planning tools, not official government or installer quotes.
- Investment and decision-system pages are allocation and planning tools, not personalized regulated financial advice.

Stock planning: /tools/stock-planner provides editable replenishment scenarios with synthetic examples; no live inventory, purchasing or POS integration is enabled. Related guide: /blog/decision-support/how-to-prioritize-stock-reorders.

The stock planner includes a small statistical forecast lab using browser-local daily history and chronological baseline comparisons. Advanced ML/LLM assistance and POS/ERP connectors are scoped custom options, not enabled public-demo integrations.

Synthetic integration workflow demos: /tools/order-review-demo validates sample order lines before local draft export; /tools/migration-evidence-demo runs bounded browser mapping comparisons. Neither connects AI, uploads documents, converts real projects, executes compilers or writes to an ERP. Related guides: /blog/integration/purchase-order-review-before-erp-import and /blog/integration/integration-migration-needs-behaviour-tests. Private Ollama hosting and production integrations are custom pilot options, not enabled features.

Shared services: /tools/community-fund-demo is a synthetic single-month contribution/cost worksheet, not a live financial ledger or payment service. It distinguishes outstanding contributions from a structural budget gap and protects unallocated excess receipts. Summary export contains aggregates only. No AI, notifications or banking connector. Guide: /blog/decision-support/manage-shared-service-contributions.
